title: Saplings to Stick
description: Simple as that just 1 sapling for 1 stick
body:
# All this mod dose is any sapling can be a stick
![Sapling --> Stick](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65d17e8b8644f22b7c3976c3f7406cf769103a4f.png)

**You ever wanted to have more sticks?**

> If yes then this is the mod for you

> If no don`t download it 

**_It Should work with any sapling from other mods to make it into a stick_**
